title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Fantastic soundboard capture of a scorching show featuring Shakedown Street, Scarlet Fire and an electrifying Truckin’>Other One>Stella Blue>Sugar Magnolia close.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the hot energy of this performance – the first set ignites with Shakedown Street and rare Diamond Blues while the second set builds to a blistering finish with Truckin’, The Other One, Stella Blue and Sugar Magnolia. The soundboard source is described as fantastic and crystal‑clear, making the musical fire easy to enjoy.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both the musical performance (standout songs, high energy) and the soundboard recording quality; average reviewer stars = 4.5 supports a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Board copy described as fantastic and clear; no technical flaws or dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as unusually hot with strong openings; second set opens with Scarlet Fire and closes with a high‑energy sequence of Truckin’>Other One>Stella Blue>Sugar Magnolia.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's introduction into The Other One literally shook the Garden, highlighting his powerful bass presence.
